Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 9
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly replaced the widely accepted creation/recognition date of Vatican City (11 February 1929, when the Lateran Treaty was signed establishing the Vatican City State) with 7 June 1929 (the ratification/entry-into-force date). This conflated ratification with the moment it “became its own country,” leading to a nonstandard/incorrect specific answer for the question.
